name: Get Claim Pending Data
Get Claim Approved Data
Fetch Purpose
Update Member Dependent
script:
member = frappe.db.get_value(
    'Insurance Member',
    {'employee': doc.employee, 'docstatus': 1},
    ['name', 'insurance_scheme'],
    as_dict=True
)

if member:
    scheme = None
    if member.insurance_scheme:
        scheme = frappe.db.get_value('Support Scheme', member.insurance_scheme, 'scheme')

    allow_for_dependents = 0
    if scheme:
        allow_for_dependents = frappe.db.get_value('Insurance Scheme', scheme, 'allow_for_dependents')

    if allow_for_dependents:
        member_doc = frappe.get_doc('Insurance Member', member.name)
        ageto = frappe.db.get_value('Insurance Period', {'status': 'Active'}, 'valid_from')

        if not ageto:
            frappe.throw('No Active Insurance Period found')

        dayto = frappe.utils.getdate(ageto)
        frappe.db.set_value('Insurance Member', member_doc.name, 'docstatus', 0)
        member_doc.reload()
        member_doc.set('dependents', [])

        for row in doc.dependents:
            dob = frappe.utils.getdate(row.date_of_birth)
            age = dayto.year - dob.year

            if (dayto.month, dayto.day) < (dob.month, dob.day):
                age = age - 1

            if age < 25 or row.relationship == 'Spouse':
                member_doc.append('dependents', {
                    'name_with_initials': row.name_with_initials,
                    'age'               : age,
                    'relationship'      : row.relationship,
                    'cert'              : row.marriage_birth_certificate,
                })

        member_doc.save()
        member_doc.submit()

        frappe.msgprint(f'Document {member_doc.name} updated successfully')

name: Update Claim Group Status
script:
summary_id = frappe.form_dict.get("summary_id")
if not summary_id:
    frappe.throw("summary_id is required")

groups = frappe.get_all(
    "Employee Claim Group",
    filters={"summary_id": summary_id, "group_status": "Not Printed"},
    pluck="name"
)

for group_name in groups:
    group_doc = frappe.get_doc("Employee Claim Group", group_name)
    group_doc.group_status = "Active"
    group_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    claims = frappe.get_all(
        "Insurance Claim",
        filters={"group_no": group_name, "claim_status": "Accepted by Manager"},
        pluck="name"
    )

    for claim_name in claims:
        claim_doc = frappe.get_doc("Insurance Claim", claim_name)
        claim_doc.claim_status = "Sent to Doctor"
        claim_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

if summary_id:
    summary_doc = frappe.get_doc("Claim Summary", summary_id)
    summary_doc.summary_status = "Downloaded"
    summary_doc.printed_date = frappe.utils.now().split(".")[0]
    summary_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.response["message"] = {"updated_groups": len(groups)}

script:
today = frappe.utils.today()
#For testing
# today = str(frappe.utils.get_last_day(frappe.utils.today()))

last_day = frappe.utils.get_last_day(today)

if today != str(last_day):
    frappe.log_error("Not last day, skipping", "Group No Generator")
else:
    verified_claims = frappe.get_all(
        'Insurance Claim',
        filters={
            'claim_status': 'Accepted by Manager',
            'docstatus': 1,
            'group_no': '',#Comment For testing
            'group_month': ''#Comment For testing
        },
        fields=['name', 'empins', 'claim_type'],
        order_by='empins asc'
    )

    if not verified_claims:
        frappe.log_error("No verified claims found", "Group No Generator")
    else:
        
        now = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
        month_year = str(now.year) + "-" + str(now.month).zfill(2)

        employee_claim_count = {}
        for claim in verified_claims:
            form_doc = frappe.get_doc("Insurance Form", claim.claim_type)

                employee = claim['empins']
                employee_claim_count[employee] = employee_claim_count.get(employee, 0) + 1
        
        doc_sum = frappe.new_doc("Claim Summary")
        
        records = frappe.db.get_list("Claim Summary",
            filters={"year_month_id": ["like", f"{month_year}%"]},
            fields=["name"]
        )

        for record in records:
            frappe.db.set_value("Claim Summary", record.name, "isdownload", 0)
        
        doc_count = frappe.db.count("Claim Summary", filters={"year_month_id": ["like", f"{month_year}%"]})
                
        if doc_count > 0:
            doc_sum.year_month_id = month_year + "-" + str(doc_count)
        else:
            doc_sum.year_month_id = month_year
        
        doc_sum.no_of_members = len(employee_claim_count)
        doc_sum.created_date = today
        doc_sum.printed_date = ""
        doc_sum.isdownload = 1
        doc_sum.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        employee_group_no = {}
        for employee, count in employee_claim_count.items():
            doc_group = frappe.new_doc("Employee Claim Group")
            doc_group.employee = employee
            doc_group.no_of_claims = count
            doc_group.print_status = "Not Printed"
            doc_group.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

            employee_group_no[employee] = doc_group.name
            
        for claim in verified_claims:
            employee = claim['empins']
            form_doc = frappe.get_doc("Insurance Form", claim.claim_type)
            if(form_doc.monthly_summary):
                group_no = employee_group_no[employee]
                frappe.db.set_value(
                    'Insurance Claim',
                    claim['name'],
                    {
                        'group_no': group_no,
                        'group_month': doc_sum.year_month_id
                    },
                    update_modified=False
                )
            else:
                doc_group = frappe.new_doc("Employee Claim Group")
                doc_group.employee = employee
                doc_group.no_of_claims = 1
                doc_group.print_status = "Not Printed"
                doc_group.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                
                frappe.db.set_value(
                    'Insurance Claim',
                    claim['name'],
                    {
                        'group_no': doc_group.name,
                        'group_month': doc_sum.year_month_id
                    },
                    update_modified=False
                )

        frappe.db.commit()
        frappe.log_error("Group No generated successfully", "Group No Generator")

name: Monthly Claim Group - Once
script:
today_date = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.today())
month_last_day = frappe.utils.get_last_day(today_date)

if today_date.day <= 7 and today_date != month_last_day:
    ref_date = frappe.utils.add_months(today_date, -1)
else:
    ref_date = today_date

last_day = str(frappe.utils.get_last_day(ref_date))

if today_date.day <= 4:
    should_run = True
else:
    should_run = (str(today_date) == last_day)

if not should_run:
    frappe.log_error("Group No Generator", "Not last day, skipping")
else:
    verified_claims = frappe.get_all(
        'Insurance Claim',
        filters={
            'claim_status': 'Accepted by Manager',
            'checked_by_officer': 'Accepted',
            'docstatus': 1,
            'group_no': '',
            'group_month': '',
            'modified': ['<=', f"{last_day} 23:59:59"]
        },
        fields=['name', 'empins', 'claim_type'],
        order_by='empins asc'
    )

    now = frappe.utils.get_datetime(last_day)
    month_year = str(now.year) + "-" + str(now.month).zfill(2)

    if not verified_claims:
        frappe.log_error("Group No Generator", "No verified claims found")
    else:

        employee_claim_count = {}
        for claim in verified_claims:
            form_doc = frappe.get_doc("Insurance Form", claim.claim_type)
            if form_doc.monthly_summary:
                employee = claim['empins']
                employee_claim_count[employee] = employee_claim_count.get(employee, 0) + 1

        existing_doc = frappe.db.get_value("Claim Summary", {"year_month_id": month_year}, "name")

        if existing_doc:
            doc_sum = frappe.get_doc("Claim Summary", existing_doc)
            doc_sum.created_date = today_date
            doc_sum.printed_date = ""
            doc_sum.summary_status = "Not Downloaded"
            doc_sum.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        else:
            doc_sum = frappe.new_doc("Claim Summary")
            doc_sum.year_month_id = month_year
            doc_sum.no_of_members = 0
            doc_sum.created_date = today_date
            doc_sum.printed_date = ""
            doc_sum.summary_status = "Not Downloaded"
            doc_sum.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        employee_group_no = {}
        for employee, count in employee_claim_count.items():
            existing_group = frappe.db.get_value(
                "Employee Claim Group",
                {"employee": employee, "summary_id": doc_sum.name},
                "name"
            )

            if existing_group:
                doc_group = frappe.get_doc("Employee Claim Group", existing_group)
                doc_group.no_of_claims = (doc_group.no_of_claims or 0) + count
                doc_group.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            else:
                doc_group = frappe.new_doc("Employee Claim Group")
                doc_group.employee = employee
                doc_group.no_of_claims = count
                doc_group.group_status = "Active"
                doc_group.summary_id = doc_sum.name
                doc_group.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

            employee_group_no[employee] = doc_group.name

        for claim in verified_claims:
            employee = claim['empins']
            form_doc = frappe.get_doc("Insurance Form", claim.claim_type)
            if form_doc.monthly_summary:
                group_no = employee_group_no[employee]
                # frappe.db.set_value(
                #     'Insurance Claim',
                #     claim['name'],
                #     {
                #         'group_no': group_no,
                #         'group_month': doc_sum.year_month_id
                #     },
                #     update_modified=False
                # )
                in_doc = frappe.get_doc('Insurance Claim', claim['name'])
                in_doc.group_no = group_no
                in_doc.group_month = doc_sum.year_month_id
                in_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            else:
                doc_group = frappe.new_doc("Employee Claim Group")
                doc_group.employee = employee
                doc_group.no_of_claims = 1
                doc_group.group_status = "Active"
                doc_group.summary_id = doc_sum.name
                doc_group.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

                # frappe.db.set_value(
                #     'Insurance Claim',
                #     claim['name'],
                #     {
                #         'group_no': doc_group.name,
                #         'group_month': doc_sum.year_month_id
                #     },
                #     update_modified=False
                # )
                in_doc = frappe.get_doc('Insurance Claim', claim['name'])
                in_doc.group_no = doc_group.name
                in_doc.group_month = doc_sum.year_month_id
                in_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

        # recalculate no_of_members from actual Employee Claim Group records tied to this summary
        member_employees = frappe.db.get_list(
            "Employee Claim Group",
            filters={"summary_id": doc_sum.name},
            fields=["employee"],
            distinct=True
        )
        doc_sum.no_of_members = len(member_employees)
        doc_sum.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    # ---- runs regardless of whether verified_claims was empty ----
    # fetch current month's summary (if it exists) and backfill missing Claim Approvals

    current_summary = frappe.db.get_value("Claim Summary", {"year_month_id": month_year}, "name")

    if current_summary:
        all_groups = frappe.get_all(
            "Employee Claim Group",
            filters={"summary_id": current_summary},
            fields=["name", "employee"]
        )

        for group in all_groups:
            existing_approval = frappe.db.get_value(
                "Claim Approval", {"claim_group": group.name}, "name"
            )
            if not existing_approval:
                doc_mem = frappe.get_doc("Insurance Member", {"employee": group.employee})
                doc_approval = frappe.new_doc("Claim Approval")
                doc_approval.claim_group = group.name
                doc_approval.employee = doc_mem.name
                doc_approval.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                
    frappe.db.commit()
    frappe.log_error("Group No Generator", "Group No generated successfully")
